text: The property F G p ('eventually p holds forever') is:
choices: Expressible in CTL but not in LTL
Expressible in neither LTL nor CTL
Expressible in LTL but not in CTL
explanation: F G p is a canonical LTL formula (the 'persistence' pattern) that CTL cannot express, because it constrains a single path rather than the branching structure. Choice 0 has it backwards — AG(EF p) is the CTL-but-not-LTL example. F G p is a liveness-style property, not safety.
